superseded_statement: No interventional stromal- or fibroblast-directed trial had been conducted in RA.
correction: False. TRAFIC was an open-label phase 1b dose-finding study of the CDK inhibitor seliciclib in RA active despite anti-TNF; 15 patients across five cohorts, MTD 400 mg. The narrower claim survives: no stromal-directed agent has been tested in a biopsy- or signature-selected RA population.
cause: The Phase 4 registry sweep used fibroblast, anti-fibrotic and FAP terms and missed cell-cycle inhibitors.

superseded_statement: The 1992 food-intolerance finding was never followed up.
correction: It was followed up. A chain of blinded food-challenge work runs from 1983 to 2006. The genuine gap is the twenty years of silence since 2006.
cause: Retrieval gap in the Phase 4 search strategy, recorded as a research gap.

superseded_statement: Press coverage of the anti-IL-1alpha phase 2 cites NCT05363917.
correction: The registry entry matching the reported design and enrolment is NCT05363891. Both are RA phase 2 registrations from the same sponsor; neither has posted results.

superseded_statement: No prospective trial has tested a de-escalation or non-escalation strategy in imaging-negative refractory RA.
correction: NCT05717179 does exactly this. The apparent gap was a retrieval gap. RL-03 was downgraded.
cause: Registry sweep did not reach the trial.

superseded_statement: PMID 41328586 is the next-generation cell-cycle-inhibitor trial in RA patients.
correction: That record is a review summarising the trial. The trial is a separate randomised, placebo-controlled, multiple-ascending-dose study.
It used semiquantitative immunohistochemistry scored by a masked pathologist combined with a validated 73-gene RNA-seq B-cell panel.

Too broad. External cohort validation exists for the STRAP-derived tocilizumab and rituximab models in R4RA; not for the etanercept model. R4RA's multidrug-resistance model is internally cross-validated only.

superseded_statement: RL-01's subgroup effect is defined by ACPA status, and its prespecification status is unresolved.
correction: Resolved against the lead. The 4-year paper states the risk-stratified analysis within the ACPA-negative group was not in the published analysis plan; no interaction test and no multiplicity adjustment are reported. The lead was reframed as imaging-burden-selected, not ACPA-selected.
cause: Subgroup basis read from the wrong axis of the published analysis.

superseded_statement: The 5-year and 4-year TREAT EARLIER results are two pieces of evidence.
